projects.title: Nepal Multi-Hazard Precursor Framework
projects.summary: Two proposed satellite precursor tracks for landslide and cryosphere-related flood hazards in the Bhote Koshi–Trishuli corridor, Nepal.
projects.status: [FILL: current stage — proposal / pilot underway / PhD-track]
projects.problem: Mountain hazards can cascade across slopes and river corridors. The proposed research tests whether satellite-derived precursors can support a defensible screening workflow.
projects.data: [FILL: confirmed precipitation, slope-motion, snow, lake and field-reference datasets for Nepal]
projects.method: Proposed tracks: rainfall and hydrogeological triggers for landslides; cryosphere-related signals for flood precursor research. Thresholds and validation design remain to be specified.
projects.demonstrated: Conceptual two-track research scope; warning skill has not been demonstrated.

projects.title: VRFSZ — Vertical-Reference Flood-Risk Screening
projects.summary: Paired DeltaDTM elevation references and Sentinel-1 flood detections examine changes in low-elevation screening across the GBM delta.
projects.status: [FILL: current stage — under review / published / pilot area size]
projects.problem: Low-elevation screening can change when the vertical reference of terrain data changes, affecting how flood exposure is interpreted.
projects.data: Paired DeltaDTM elevation references and Sentinel-1 SAR event observations in the Ganges–Brahmaputra–Meghna delta.
projects.method: Compare low-elevation classes between paired reference surfaces; relate reclassified locations to event-specific SAR flood detection.
projects.demonstrated: Research analysis examines vertical-reference sensitivity in the GBM delta; flood occurrence data do not independently validate exposure at parcel scale.

projects.title: Water & Terrain Intelligence
projects.summary: GRACE/GRACE-FO water storage and SPEI analysis alongside satellite DEM benchmarking for Bangladesh floodplain terrain.
projects.status: [FILL: current stage — JSTARS revision in progress / etc.]
projects.problem: Water storage signals and elevation errors require separate interpretation before they can inform floodplain decisions.
projects.data: GRACE/GRACE-FO TWSA and SPEI for water analysis; SRTM, NASADEM, Copernicus GLO-30, ALOS AW3D30, ICESat-1 GLAS water heights and Survey of Bangladesh land heights for DEM evaluation.
projects.method: Compare TWSA with drought indices; benchmark four terrain products against water and land height references in Sirajganj.
projects.demonstrated: Comparative terrain benchmarking and water-storage analysis are research workflows. TWSA alone does not establish groundwater depletion.
projects.limitations: [FILL: verified limitations for TWSA–SPEI work and DEM reference comparison]
